work_culture.hierarchy: Flat to moderate. First-name basis with executives.
work_culture.hours: 40-hour norm. Startup culture may expect more.
work_culture.remote: Widespread remote/hybrid adoption. Top talent market is national.
work_culture.diversity_focus: DEI programs standard. Pay equity reporting in some states.

managerial_authority.budget_thresholds: Department heads: $50K-$250K. Directors: $250K-$1M. VP+: $1M+. CFO/CEO approval above thresholds.
managerial_authority.hiring_authority: No formal notice period. Quick hires. At-will termination.
managerial_authority.termination: At-will. No statutory severance. WARN Act for mass layoffs (60 days).

industry_context.saas: Silicon Valley standard. ARR-driven. Board-controlled governance.
industry_context.fintech: SEC/FINRA regulated. New York/San Francisco hubs.
industry_context.healthcare: HIPAA critical. FDA for healthtech. Boston/Minnesota hubs.
industry_context.manufacturing: Midwest and Sun Belt. Union presence varies by state.
